svg.title: git log: career timeline 2015 to now
svg.desc: An amber phosphor terminal runs git log --graph. Newest first: Jul 2026 to now, merge capital-one and rejoin Freddie Mac, ML forecasting platform with FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS serving models. May 2025 to Jul 2026, Capital One, finance, credit cards: 50+ AWS microservice platform, event-driven serverless pipeline (EventBridge, Lambda, DynamoDB Streams, Step Functions, Glue/Spark), React/TS and Python, Playwright BDD, feature flags. Jan 2023 to May 2025, Freddie Mac, led the backend team: 3000 to 1000 line refactor with 20% faster performance, over 85% coverage, Tableau PoC to production, local RAG. Apr 2022 to Jan 2023, Agero: FastAPI on AWS Lambda from scratch, S3 events to EventBridge to Lambda to MongoDB, GitHub Actions. May 2019 to Apr 2022, Humana, specialty pharmacy, led the backend agile team: Tesseract OCR services in Flask integrated with .NET apps, Django, React. Jun 2018 to May 2019, McKesson, pharma SaaS: Flask and MS SQL, Angular and C# Web API, Express portal with TDD. Sep 2017 to May 2018, Woolworths Sydney, retail: ASP.NET/C# N-tier, Azure App Insights, Sev-1 incident response. Jan 2016 to Aug 2017, CVS Health, pharmacy apps, led API development: AngularJS SPA from scratch on Web API and SQL Server. 2015, Anna University, BE Mechanical Engineering: initial commit, from gears to graphs.
